scope: Lone-participant timeout and meeting arrival notices

behavior.another_person_joins: Cancel the waiting deadline; start a fresh waiting period if they leave.
behavior.timeout: Disconnect the SDK session, destroy publishers and subscriptions, release microphone tracks, clear the live-meeting lease, and stop attendance heartbeats.
behavior.completion: Timeout does not mark the meeting complete. Hosts have a separate explicit End meeting for everyone action.
behavior.rejoin: Request fresh access through the meeting entry flow; completed sessions remain closed.
behavior.counting: Unique connection identities, including audio-only participants; camera and screen-share streams do not count as separate people.
behavior.arrivals: Named join notices in the video room; named lobby arrivals with waiting counts; app toasts include presence and admission counts and resurface on a new arrival after dismissal.

validation.browser_scope: Local Chromium, mocked SDK, accelerated clock

limits: Timeout enforcement is in the video client, using absolute deadlines checked by timer and on tab resume. It is not a provider-side billing cutoff while a browser process is fully suspended.
App presence notices poll every 15 seconds and exclude presence older than 90 seconds.
Live provider billing and real-device sleep/reconnect behavior require verification.
